title: L0181
description: Output of an L0181 program — a flashcard deck, plus whatever study state the learner has added.

id.description: The card's position in the authored deck, from 0.

front.description: The prompt, shown first. Prose, LaTeX math in $...$, or an image URL.

back.description: The answer, shown once the card is flipped.

theme.description: Which theme the deck opens in.

response.description: The learner's study state, added by the player and carried back on each recompile.

marks.description: How the learner rated each card, keyed by card id.

cardId.description: The id of the card the learner is on.

stack.description: Which stack the learner is working through.
